Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to verify the initial search results from WebSurfer. In Step 1, WebSurfer reported that the series was streaming on "Amazon Prime Video," but the Planner immediately accepted this as a primary finding without cross-referencing the visible evidence in the same screenshot (which clearly showed Wikipedia stating the series "premiered on March 16, 2017, on Crackle"). Instead of correcting the course or prioritizing the more authoritative source visible in the results, the Planner proceeded to instruct further searches based on the incorrect premise, leading to a cycle of redundant queries that failed to resolve the conflict between the initial search result and the visible Wikipedia data.
